title: MK8DX Frame Description V1
description: What the ROI Searcher hands to the ROI Matcher for one canonical frame (CENTRAL_RECOGNITION.md section 8.3). It records what is on screen; every interpretation is versioned central code. The pixels travel beside it: in process as the canonical image, in parity vectors as a lossless PNG whose SHA-256 is recorded here.

frame.description: The screen. Values are added when a frame type joins the pipeline.

console.description: Provenance. One frame definition serves both consoles until a capture proves a frame differs.

residual.description: Colour-correction fit of the frame (searcher's panel or card photometry); null when not measured. The matcher uses it to judge how far colour evidence can be trusted.

locale.description: Console language when known (Clean Assets name locale, e.g. en-GB).

slot.description: Rough position [x, y, w, h] in the canonical frame; the matcher refines around it.

printedText.description: The OCR line of a printed name in or beside this field, as read (a clue, never a decision).

candidates.description: Optional app candidate scope (section 8.4). Narrows the comparison; never makes an answer certain on its own.
